problem: Instagram Mira had an immutable daily winner and strong publication gates, but the research corpus was stale and the selected winner could still come from a static calendar seed instead of current public human-problem evidence.
root_cause: Source ingestion, recommendation materialization, winner selection and outcome learning were separate lineages. Fresh complaint/blog/forum evidence was not a mandatory upstream input to Mira ranking.
decision: Create one canonical source-backed lineage: public complaint/blog/forum signals -> scored private-life problem -> recommendation -> immutable Instagram winner -> Mira media/publish -> social metrics -> winner/source learning writeback.
prevention: Run the complaint radar every six hours for the next Amsterdam run date.
Prefer source-backed Mira recommendations over static calendar seeds.
Keep the winner immutable after selection.
Write post and metric outcomes back to the same source/recommendation/winner lineage.
